runner_tagline.message: Runs the tests a team instance asks for, on this machine.
runner_tagline.description: Under the app's name, at the top of the window: what Piwi Runner does.

runner_connectionHeading.description: Heading of the card that connects Piwi Runner to a team instance. The feature's name on the instance's pages.

runner_runsHeading.description: Heading of the list of the runs this window started.

runner_noRuns.message: No runs yet. When a team instance asks for tests, you confirm them here first.
runner_noRuns.description: In place of the list of runs, while there is none.

runner_statusRunning.description: Badge of a run: its tests are running.

runner_statusPassed.description: Badge of a run: every test passed.

runner_statusFailed.description: Badge of a run: a test failed.

runner_statusStopped.description: Badge of a run: the person stopped it before it ended.

runner_statusError.description: Badge of a run: it could not start, or Playwright ended with an error.

runner_stopping.description: Badge of a run, and label of its Stop button, once Stop was clicked and the run has not ended yet.

runner_stopNow.description: Button, once Stop was clicked and the run has not ended yet: ends it at once.

runner_holdFailures.description: Switch of a running run: a failed test waits at its failure for the person to look before the run goes on.

runner_holdFailuresHint.message: A failed test waits here for you to look before the run goes on.
runner_holdFailuresHint.description: Under the Hold failures switch: what it does.

runner_output.description: Summary of the collapsed block that shows a run's terminal output.

runner_stillRunning.message: Still running from before the window reloaded
runner_stillRunning.description: On a run the window has no entry for: it was started before the window reloaded and still runs.

runner_backgroundHeading.description: Heading of the card of the settings that keep Piwi Runner running when its window is closed.

runner_runInBackground.description: Checkbox of the window, and the same item in the tray menu: closing the window keeps Piwi Runner in the tray.

runner_runInBackgroundHint.message: Closing the window keeps Piwi Runner in the tray: the instance reaches this machine only while it runs. Turned off, closing the window quits it.
runner_runInBackgroundHint.description: Under the Run in background checkbox: what it does.

runner_startOnLogin.description: Checkbox, and the same item in the tray menu: Piwi Runner starts when the person signs in to their computer.

runner_startOnLoginHint.message: Starts Piwi Runner in the tray when you sign in.
runner_startOnLoginHint.description: Under the Start on login checkbox: what it does.

runner_saveFailed.description: Title of an error notification: a setting could not be saved. The reason follows below it.

runner_languageHeading.description: Heading of the card that chooses the language of Piwi Runner's own texts.

runner_languageSystem.description: First choice of the Language setting: follow the computer's language. $language$ is that language's name in itself, such as Français.

runner_languageHint.message: The language of Piwi Runner's own texts. Test titles, files, commands and the tests' output stay as they are.
runner_languageHint.description: Under the Language setting: what it changes, and what it never translates.

runner_languageDraft.message: This translation is a draft: no native reader has reviewed it yet.
runner_languageDraft.description: Under the Language setting, while the language on screen is a draft translation. Followed by runner_languageDraftLink.

runner_languageDraftLink.description: Link after runner_languageDraft: opens the form to suggest a correction to a translation.

runner_languageFailed.description: Title of an error notification: the language could not be saved. The reason follows below it.

shell_trayTooltip.description: Tooltip of the app's icon in the system tray (the menu bar on macOS). $app$ is the app's name.

shell_open.description: Item of the tray menu: brings the app's window to the front. $app$ is the app's name.

shell_showLogs.description: Item of the tray menu: shows the app's log file in the file manager.

shell_checkUpdates.description: Item of the tray menu: looks for a newer version of the app. The ellipsis says it asks a question before it acts.

shell_quit.description: Item of the tray menu and of the macOS app menu: quits the app. $app$ is the app's name.

shell_quitQuestion.description: Title of the question asked before quitting stops the test runs going. $app$ is the app's name.

shell_quitButton.description: Button of the question asked before quitting: quits, and stops the runs going.

shell_cancel.description: Button of a question of the app: does nothing and closes it.

shell_runsGoingQuit_one.message: $count$ local test run is still running: quitting stops it.
shell_runsGoingQuit_one.description: Body of the question asked before quitting, while runs are going, singular.

shell_runsGoingQuit_other.message: $count$ local test runs are still running: quitting stops them.
shell_runsGoingQuit_other.description: Body of the question asked before quitting, while runs are going, plural.

shell_runsGoingUpdate_one.message: $count$ local test run is still running: updating stops it.
shell_runsGoingUpdate_one.description: Body of the question asked before an update installs, while runs are going, singular.

shell_runsGoingUpdate_other.message: $count$ local test runs are still running: updating stops them.
shell_runsGoingUpdate_other.description: Body of the question asked before an update installs, while runs are going, plural.

shell_runsGoingRestart_one.message: $count$ local test run is still running: restarting stops it.
shell_runsGoingRestart_one.description: Body of the question asked before the app restarts, while runs are going, singular.

shell_runsGoingRestart_other.message: $count$ local test runs are still running: restarting stops them.
shell_runsGoingRestart_other.description: Body of the question asked before the app restarts, while runs are going, plural.

shell_restartQuestion.description: Title of the question asked before the app restarts to finish an update, while runs are going.

shell_restartButton.description: Button of the question asked before the app restarts: restarts it, and stops the runs going.

shell_splashSlow.message: The local host is taking longer than usual to start. Still waiting: the window opens once it is up.
shell_splashSlow.description: On the start screen, when the app's local server is slow to start.

shell_splashRestarting.message: The local host stopped. Restarting it: the window opens again once it is up.
shell_splashRestarting.description: On the start screen, while the app's local server restarts.

shell_splashStopped.message: The local host stopped and could not be restarted. Quit and relaunch $app$.
shell_splashStopped.description: On the start screen, once the app's local server could not be restarted. $app$ is the app's name.

shell_updateCheckFailed.description: A dialog: looking for a newer version failed. $error$ is the reason, in English.

shell_updateUnsupported.message: This build of $app$ cannot update itself. Get new versions from $page$.
shell_updateUnsupported.description: A dialog: this copy of the app has no updater. $page$ is the address of the releases page.

shell_updateLatest.description: A dialog: no newer version exists. $version$ is a version number.

shell_updateTitle.description: Title of the dialog that offers a newer version.

shell_updateAvailable.message: $app$ $offered$ is available (you have $installed$). It installs now, then $app$ restarts.
shell_updateAvailable.description: Body of the dialog that offers a newer version. $offered$ and $installed$ are version numbers. Followed by shell_updateWhatsNew on its own paragraph.

shell_updateWhatsNew.description: Last paragraph of the dialog that offers a newer version. $page$ is the address of the releases page.

shell_updateInstall.description: Button of the dialog that offers a newer version: installs it, then restarts the app.

shell_updateNotNow.description: Button of the dialog that offers a newer version: closes it.

shell_updateQuestion.description: Title of the question asked before an update installs, while runs are going.

shell_updateButton.description: Button of the question asked before an update installs: installs it, and stops the runs going.

shell_updateDownloading.description: Tooltip of the tray icon while an update downloads.

shell_updateDownloadingPercent.description: Tooltip of the tray icon while an update downloads. $percent$ is a number from 0 to 100.

shell_updateFailed.description: A dialog: the update could not be installed. $error$ is the reason, in English.

shell_splashStarting.description: First line of the start screen, while the app's local server starts.

shell_pickFolderTitle.message: Choose your copy of the project's code: the folder with playwright.config.ts
shell_pickFolderTitle.description: Title of the system's folder picker that links a requested run's project to a folder. Keep the file name as it is.

shell_useFolderTitle.description: Title of the question asked before a found folder is linked to a project. Its path comes first in the body.

shell_useFolderBody.message: Piwi runs the tests this project's requests ask for in this folder, once you click Run.
shell_useFolderBody.description: Body of the question asked before a found folder is linked, under the folder's path. Run is the window's Run button (runui_requestRun in the layer's catalog), as that catalog says it.

shell_useFolderButton.description: Button of the question asked before a found folder is linked: links it.

shell_betterFolderTitle.message: Link the folder that holds the tests?
shell_betterFolderTitle.description: Title of the question asked when the picked folder does not hold the request's tests but a folder above or below it does.

shell_betterFolderNotIn.message: The tests of this request are not in $folder$.
shell_betterFolderNotIn.description: First paragraph of the question shell_betterFolderTitle. $folder$ is the path of the folder picked.

shell_betterFolderIn.message: They are in $folder$, which holds the Playwright config: Playwright runs there.
shell_betterFolderIn.description: Second paragraph of the question shell_betterFolderTitle. $folder$ is the path of the folder that holds the tests.

shell_betterFolderLink.description: Button of the question shell_betterFolderTitle: links the folder that holds the tests.

shell_betterFolderKeep.description: Button of the question shell_betterFolderTitle: links the folder picked.

shell_updateNotification.description: Title of the system notification that a newer version is out. $version$ is a version number.

shell_updateInstallFrom.message: Install it from $menu$ in the tray icon's menu, or download it from the latest release.
shell_updateInstallFrom.description: Body of the system notification that a newer version is out. $menu$ is the tray item shell_checkUpdates.
